privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At ZYRCA, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and website. The data controller responsible for your personal data is Driss Belhoussine.

controller.content:

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content:
We may collect the following types of information:

• Account Information: Email address, display name, and profile photo when you sign in with Google or Sign in with Apple through Firebase Authentication. We also receive a Firebase user ID to identify your account.
• Optional Profile Information: Gender and date of birth are optional. You may provide them in profile settings; they are not required to use core fasting and tracking features.
• Health and Wellness Data: Fasting schedules and history, water intake, weight measurements, journal or daily reflection entries, sleep, activity, and meal data you voluntarily enter, plus achievements and related progress statistics.
• Guest and Local Data: If you use ZYRCA without signing in, this data is stored locally on your device. If you later create an account, you may choose to sync local data to the cloud.
• Subscription Information: Subscription entitlement status and purchase history metadata managed through RevenueCat, including RevenueCat App User IDs linked to your Firebase account when you sign in. Apple or Google processes payments; we do not receive or store payment card details.
• Identifiers: Firebase user ID; RevenueCat App User ID (and anonymous RevenueCat identifiers before you sign in); Firebase Analytics app instance identifiers; on iOS, the Identifier for Advertisers (IDFA) when you grant App Tracking Transparency permission; on Android, the Advertising ID where available and permitted.
• Analytics Information: Through Google Firebase Analytics on iOS and Android, we receive information about app interactions and related device and app metadata. Our custom analytics events measure onboarding, sign-up, login, paywall views, purchase events, and subscription-related events. We configure these events not to include your email, name, Firebase user ID, or other direct personal identifiers as custom event parameters.
• Device and Technical Information: Device type, operating system version, app version, language settings, and notification preferences when you enable reminders.
• Advertising Data: Device identifiers and related data used by Google AdMob and its partners to serve, measure, and personalize ads where permitted.
• Diagnostic Information: Limited technical logs and error information used to diagnose issues and maintain app stability on your device.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content:
We use collected information to:

• Provide and maintain the ZYRCA application and its features
• Authenticate accounts and sync data through Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore
• Deliver fasting guidance, wellness insights, and educational content
• Manage premium subscription entitlements and status through RevenueCat (payments are processed by Apple or Google)
• Send notifications related to your fasting schedule and health goals when you enable them
• Measure app usage, onboarding, authentication, paywall, and subscription funnels through Firebase Analytics on iOS and Android
• Display advertisements through Google AdMob and honor your advertising consent choices through Google UMP and platform permissions
• Diagnose errors and maintain app stability
• Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service

analytics.title: Analytics (Firebase Analytics)
analytics.content:
ZYRCA uses Google Firebase Analytics on both iOS and Android. Firebase Analytics helps us understand how the app is used and improve onboarding, subscriptions, and reliability.

We use Firebase Analytics to measure app interactions and funnel events such as onboarding start and completion, guest continue, sign-up, login, paywall views, purchase start, purchase success, and subscription activation, along with relevant device and app information (for example platform and app version).

Our custom event configuration is designed not to send your email, display name, Firebase user ID, or other direct personal identifiers as custom Analytics event parameters. Firebase Analytics may still collect automatic device and usage data according to Google's policies as part of the SDK's standard operation.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content:
ZYRCA integrates with the following third-party services:

• Firebase Authentication (Google): Account sign-in with Google or Sign in with Apple
• Cloud Firestore (Google): Cloud storage and sync of account-linked wellness data
• Firebase Analytics (Google): App usage and funnel analytics on iOS and Android
• Google Sign-In: Account authentication on Android and optionally on iOS
• Sign in with Apple: Account authentication on iOS
• Google User Messaging Platform (UMP): Advertising consent management where required
• RevenueCat: Subscription entitlement and status management (not payment processing)
• Apple App Store and Apple services: In-app subscription purchases and Sign in with Apple on iOS
• Google Play: In-app subscription purchases on Android
• Google AdMob: Advertising services

Payments for subscriptions are processed by Apple or Google. RevenueCat receives subscription status information from those stores to grant or revoke premium access in the app. Each third-party service has its own privacy policy. We encourage you to review them.

ads.title: Advertising, Consent, and Tracking
ads.content:
ZYRCA displays advertisements to free users through Google AdMob on iOS and Android. Ad formats may include banner ads, interstitial ads, and rewarded video ads. Premium subscribers may experience reduced or no advertising.

Personalized and non-personalized ads: Where permitted by law and your choices, AdMob and its partners may use device identifiers to deliver personalized advertising and measure ad performance. Where consent or permission is not granted, ads may be non-personalized or limited, and advertising identifiers may not be used for cross-app tracking in the same way.

Google User Messaging Platform (UMP): On supported platforms and regions, we use Google's User Messaging Platform to collect and record your advertising consent choices before requesting certain ads. If consent is required and not granted, the app may not request ads that require that consent.

iOS App Tracking Transparency (ATT): On iOS, after the UMP flow where applicable, the app may request Apple's App Tracking Transparency permission if status is not yet determined. If you allow tracking, the Identifier for Advertisers (IDFA) may be used for personalized advertising and measurement as permitted. If you deny tracking, IDFA is not available for cross-app tracking in the same way, and you are not tracked across other companies' apps and websites for advertising purposes through IDFA. Not all users are tracked; tracking depends on your consent and device settings.

Android Advertising ID: On Android, the app may access the Advertising ID where required for ad delivery and measurement. You can limit ad personalization through your device and Google account settings.

Managing your choices: You can adjust ad personalization in your device privacy settings, Google account ad settings, and through consent prompts shown in the app where applicable.

storage.title: Data Storage and Security
storage.content:
Account-linked data is stored in Cloud Firestore using Firebase cloud infrastructure with industry-standard encryption. Guest data and app preferences may be stored locally on your device. This website may store theme and language preferences in your browser's local storage. We do not use tracking cookies on this website.

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of electronic storage is 100% secure.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content:
We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services.

When you delete your account through the in-app deletion flow (Settings → Account → Danger Zone), we delete your associated cloud and local data and remove your Firebase Authentication account when deletion completes successfully. Deletion may require re-authentication with your sign-in provider. If a cloud deletion step fails, local data on your device may be preserved until deletion succeeds on retry.

After account deletion, Firebase Analytics, Google AdMob, RevenueCat, Apple, and Google may retain certain information under their own retention policies—for example aggregated analytics, advertising measurement data, or subscription and billing records required by those providers.

You may also request deletion through our Delete Account page or by contacting nextlevelapps81@gmail.com.

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR & CCPA)
rights.content:
Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:

• Access: Request a copy of your personal data
• Rectification: Correct inaccurate personal data
• Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data
• Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
• Objection: Object to processing of your personal data
• Restriction: Request restriction of processing

To exercise these rights, contact us at nextlevelapps81@gmail.com. We will respond within 30 days.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: ZYRCA is not intended for children under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we discover that a child has provided us with personal information, we will promptly delete it.

international.title: International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence, including through Firebase (Authentication, Firestore, and Analytics), RevenueCat, Apple, Google, Google UMP, and AdMob infrastructure. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers in compliance with applicable data protection laws.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes through the app or via email. Your continued use of ZYRCA after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

account.title: User Accounts
account.content:
You may use ZYRCA as a guest with data stored locally on your device, or create an account to sync data across devices.

On iOS, you may sign in with Apple. On Android and optionally on iOS, you may sign in with Google. Account authentication is handled through Firebase Authentication.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions and Payments
subscriptions.content:
ZYRCA offers premium features through auto-renewable subscriptions.

On iOS, Apple processes in-app purchases through the Apple App Store. On Android, Google processes in-app purchases through Google Play. RevenueCat helps us manage subscription entitlements and status in the app; it does not process your payments and does not receive payment card information.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless you cancel before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple ID account settings (App Store) or your Google Play account settings.

Billing, cancellations, and refunds are subject to the policies of Apple or Google, as applicable. We do not offer a free trial unless explicitly stated in the store listing at the time of purchase. Subscription prices are displayed in the App Store or Google Play at checkout; we do not list prices here.

Refunds, if available, must be requested through Apple or Google according to their respective refund policies.

accountDeletion.title: Account Deletion
accountDeletion.content:
You may delete your account and associated data at any time through the in-app account deletion flow. Open Settings → Account, scroll to the Danger Zone, and follow the account deletion or factory reset steps to permanently remove your data.

For detailed instructions, see our {deleteAccountLink} page. If you cannot access the app, contact us at nextlevelapps81@gmail.com.

When you confirm deletion in the app, we promptly delete your cloud and local data and remove your Firebase authentication account, subject to any legal retention requirements for subscription or tax records held by Apple or Google.

faqs.question: What is the best intermittent fasting app for beginners?
faqs.answer: ZYRCA is designed for fasting beginners and experienced users. It combines a fasting timer, water tracker, weight tracker, expert guides, and intelligent guidance — so you can start with protocols like 16:8 or 18:6 and track your progress from day one.

faqs.question: How do I start intermittent fasting with ZYRCA?
faqs.answer: Open the app, choose a fasting protocol such as 16:8, 18:6, or OMAD, and tap Start Fast. ZYRCA tracks your fasting window, sends reminders, and saves your complete fasting history.

faqs.question: Does ZYRCA have a fasting timer and water tracker?
faqs.answer: Yes. ZYRCA includes a precise fasting timer, daily water tracker, weight tracker, fasting statistics, achievements, expert guides, and PDF/CSV health report export — all in one wellness app.

faqs.question: How does ZYRCA Intelligence work?
faqs.answer: ZYRCA Intelligence provides wellness insights and helpful answers to common fasting questions. It uses built-in health knowledge and predefined guidance — it is not a dynamic AI chatbot and does not learn from your conversations.

faqs.question: Can I export my fasting and health data?
faqs.answer: Yes. ZYRCA lets you export a PDF health report and CSV data files with your fasting progress, water intake, and weight records.

faqs.question: Is ZYRCA free to use?
faqs.answer: ZYRCA offers a free tier with core fasting and tracking features. Premium subscriptions unlock additional guidance, detailed analytics, report exports, and an ad-free experience.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqs.answer: Subscriptions are managed through Google Play or the Apple App Store. Go to your store account settings, find ZYRCA under subscriptions, and select Cancel.

faqs.question: Which languages does ZYRCA support?
faqs.answer: ZYRCA is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and Arabic with full right-to-left support for Arabic.

faqs.question: Is my health data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your data is encrypted and stored securely. We never sell your personal information. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
